Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother, took it, so he gave him Achsah his daughter as his wife.

people.name: Achsah
people.line: Daughter of Caleb; wife of Othniel

people.name: Caleb
people.line: Faithful spy, given Hebron as inheritance

people.name: Kenaz

people.name: Othniel

translations.web: Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter as wife.
translations.bsb: So Othniel son of Caleb’s brother Kenaz captured the city, and Caleb gave his daughter Acsah to him in marriage.
translations.kjv: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.
